title: Wednesday, 11:20 p.m.
intro: The Grange Hall basement. HARROW's practice room. A pipe drips somewhere out of sight.

items.label: Lux's guitar case
items.text: Inside the lid, folded small: 'Go, you idiot.' Crossed out. 'Stay.' Crossed out. Then nothing, a tiny ink dot where a pen stopped.

items.label: The tape recorder
items.text: A four-track from 1989. The REC light is on. You didn't switch it on. The reels are turning, slowly, on nothing.

items.label: The wet pipes
items.text: The pipes are sweating. The drip lands in the same spot every four seconds, then every three, then, as you watch, in time with your pulse.

items.label: Fife & Drum photograph, 1960
items.text: Twelve boys in drum jackets. The one in the back row, grinning, is holding a bell-rope. His name is on the back: G. Brask. He has your nose.

items.label: Amp stack
items.text: Eleven. The knob goes to eleven. It's fine.

items.label: Cold pancakes in foil
items.text: A stack for the band. The top one has a smiley drawn in syrup. Lux's handwriting, Lux's syrup, Lux's grief.

items.label: Mic stand
items.text: Bent, at a heroic angle. It has seen things.

items.label: High basement window
items.text: A rectangle of black sky. You can't see the lake from here, but you can hear it. You wave anyway.
